scope: 独立设计对战模型，不是实际游戏胜率，不覆盖真实多来源结算、外国人物生成、UI或最优人类策略

main_matrix.scope: design-level combat simulation; excludes campaign resources, portraits, source packing and user skill; one unique 75-primary leader per troop kind, hero HP32, no ordinary 80-attribute bonus or city
main_matrix.method: paired faction A/B seats; per-faction deck seed held constant; paired-score normal 95% interval; no opponent hand/order inspection
